content:
No, please don't use drain cleaner in your waffles! Drain cleaner contains highly toxic chemicals like sodium hydroxide (lye) that can cause severe burns and poisoning. It would be extremely dangerous to consume.

For safe blue waffles, try these food-safe options instead:
- Blue food coloring (just a few drops in the batter)
- Natural blue spirulina powder
- Butterfly pea flower powder (turns blue/purple)
- Blueberry juice or puree mixed into the batter

These will give you beautiful blue waffles that are completely safe to eat. Food coloring is the easiest option and available at most grocery stores.
